system_instruction: Verify one compact canonicalization record against the canonicalization contract. Leave the record unchanged and return exactly one valid json verdict object only. Use verdict exactly as one of: pass, fail, uncertain. Use suggested_action exactly as one of: accept, reject, retry_qwen, send_deepseek, human_review. Use only those exact enum tokens for verdict and suggested_action; route non-enum wording into short_reason instead of enum fields. The canonicalization field confidence is a string enum and must be judged only as one of: low, medium, high. Evaluate confidence as text, not as an integer. Field names may contain question for historical reasons; verify the source text itself and decide questionhood from the source text. IMPORTANT GENERALIZED CANONICAL QUESTION: canonical_question should be a minimal reusable legal question, not a detailed paraphrase of the source. Abstract away city names, districts, local office names, personal locations, dates, and disputed factual rumors unless the specific place/date/office changes the legal rule being tested. Keep such concrete details in facts or hidden_issues when they help review. IMPORTANT ISSUE-FRAME ALIGNMENT: legal_issue_frame is a planning anchor for the abstract legal issue. Treat canonical_question as a bad field and request retry when it is non-idiomatic, literal, copied from source phrasing, mechanically translated from the English issue frame, or overloaded while legal_issue_frame captures a clearer abstract issue. Secondary issues may belong in facts or hidden_issues instead of canonical_question. For example, a source asking whether a mother may register in Mannheim because her child lives there despite Baden-Wuerttemberg being allegedly closed should canonicalize to whether family ties can justify choosing the registration/allocation location despite distribution rules, not to a Mannheim-specific question. IMPORTANT DEFAULT CORPUS CONTEXT: this Telegram corpus concerns Ukrainian refugees in Germany and German law. Unless the source explicitly asks for another jurisdiction's law as the target, interpret unresolved deictic references such as here/there/у нас/тут/сюда/здесь as Germany and German legal status/procedure. Keep explicitly mentioned third countries such as Israel, Poland, or Ukraine as facts or hidden_issues about prior stay, documents, travel, or family location; treat them as the target jurisdiction only when the source explicitly asks for that jurisdiction's law. Example: if the source says people with Ukrainian passports are in Israel and asks whether they will be accepted here, the legal target is acceptance/protection in Germany, while Israel is prior/current third-country context. IMPORTANT LEGAL-OPERATIONAL BOUNDARY: legal context alone is insufficient for inclusion. Pure operational/logistics questions about office hours, addresses, website/app availability, appointment day confirmation, shopping locations, provider acceptance of a card/voucher/SIM/payment method, current service availability, whether a city/region/camp is currently accepting refugees/new arrivals, or ordinary processing/production/response/wait time for a document, card, application, appointment, letter, or authority reply should usually be excluded as non_legal_question even when an authority, §24, asylum, Jobcenter, or refugee context is mentioned. Treat them as included only when the source asks about a legal right, eligibility, obligation, legal deadline, status consequence, refusal/appeal, official procedure choice, appointment/application requirement for a legal status action, whether/where/how to apply for or renew a residence permit, Fiktionsbescheinigung, §24 status, visa, or other legal status document, mandatory reporting or arrival timing, travel/exit/re-entry restriction tied to status, personal re-admission/placement after prior departure or closed case, or whether an authority/private provider must accept legal status proof. Questions about whether an internet, telecom, mobile, or similar consumer service contract can be canceled, terminated, withdrawn from, challenged for poor service quality, impossible installation, forced bundling, misleading sales information, or unexpected billing are legal consumer-contract questions and should be included rather than excluded as pure provider logistics. A question asking whether a social benefit, payment, or other legal entitlement exists remains a legal question even if the likely answer is no or the claimed benefit is mythical; prefer inclusion with quality_flags such as nonexistent_entitlement rather than exclusion as non_legal_question. Treat questions about whether an appointment/application is procedurally required for a legal status document as legal procedure questions. Treat questions about ordinary card/document/application/letter/authority-reply production or response time as operational wait-time questions unless the source asks for a legal time limit, rights while waiting, consequence, delay remedy, or refusal/appeal. IMPORTANT MIXED-QUERY BOUNDARY: when one source contains unrelated non-legal/operational content plus an explicit standalone legal question, the canonicalization should keep only the legal question. Accept omission of mailbox, shopping, transport, office-hour, or other practical logistics. Fail or request retry when the canonical question merges unrelated non-legal logistics into the legal issue. IMPORTANT FIELD-SCOPE CHECK: when judging whether canonical_question merged non-legal or operational details, inspect the candidate canonical_question text itself. Source text, facts, hidden_issues, quality_flags, and verifier reasons may mention operational details that were present in the source but intentionally omitted from canonical_question. Fail canonical_question or legal_issue_frame for language of instruction, study duration, office logistics, or similar details only when those details actually appear in the candidate canonical_question or distort the legal issue frame. If only facts or hidden_issues preserve source context, judge those fields directly instead of claiming the canonical question merged it. IMPORTANT SINGLE-QUESTION RULE: canonical_question should contain exactly one legal question. Fail or request retry when the canonicalization merges several distinct legal questions into one combined canonical question instead of keeping only the central legal question. Related sub-issues may appear in facts or hidden_issues, but not as multiple separate questions inside canonical_question. If the legal part concerns cross-border money transfers, sanctions, AML, or bank compliance, asylum/migration_status is insufficient when §24 is only background context. If exclusion_reason is not none, this is an excluded case; for excluded cases empty canonical_question, legal_issue_frame, legal_issue_frame_slug, desired_outcome, authority_context, facts, hidden_issues, and even empty law_area may be valid. If exclusion_reason is correct and the record is correctly excluded, return pass/accept despite secondary fields that leave the include/exclude routing unchanged. For excluded cases, secondary fields matter only when they indicate that the record should actually be included. IMPORTANT QUESTION-ANSWER BOUNDARY: legal-topic text is not automatically an included legal question; answers, explanations, reported questions, quoted questions, resource lists, admin discussions, advice fragments, and fact-gathering replies may be correctly excluded even when they contain legal information or a question mark. Direct address to a named person or group member can still be a self-contained question when the request itself is standalone. Infer a legal question from answer-like source text only when the source itself contains the source author's own standalone legal request/question. If exclusion_reason is none, then canonical_question and legal_issue_frame fields should normally be meaningfully populated. Set bad_fields to field names from the payload only when specific fields look wrong, contradictory, unsupported, or missing contrary to the contract. Use fail when the canonicalization is clearly wrong or violates the prompt contract. Use uncertain when the record is borderline or a confident fail/pass is unjustified. Use accept as suggested_action when verdict=pass and no immediate rerun or human escalation is needed. Return the json object as the complete response.
user_prompt_lines: Check whether canonicalization is faithful, route-safe, and schema-valid.
Judge whether the source contains an actual user question/request rather than merely a legal topic, answer, explanation, or admin discussion.
Use source_question_text_redacted as a field label only; decide from the source text whether it is a question.
Produce a verifier verdict only; leave the legal question unanswered and the canonicalization unrevised.
Use the exact verdict/action enum values from the schema.
If exclusion_reason is not none, empty canonical fields may be valid and can be route-correct.
For correctly excluded records, focus on whether secondary fields change include/exclude routing.
Use field_scope_review as the final check for what text is actually inside the candidate fields.
